abilities.name: YouTube Transcript Scraper（changefeeds，基于 Apify MCP）
abilities.description: 托管式 YouTube 转录工具。支持视频、Shorts、频道或播放列表 URL（或纯 ID），返回带时间戳片段和/或纯文本的人工或自动生成字幕，并包含标题、频道、时长、播放量和发布日期。请求通过 Apify 住宅代理发送，即使在 YouTube 机器人检测拦截直接抓取的云主机上也能正常运行。包含一个 Actor 工具 `changefeeds--youtube-transcript-scraper`，以及 Apify 的运行和数据集辅助工具。Streamable HTTP 端点：`https://mcp.apify.com/?tools=changefeeds/youtube-transcript-scraper`；认证方式：Apify OAuth 或 `Authorization: Bearer <Apify API token>`。按次计费：每次返回转录文本收费 0.004 美元，由 Apify 计费（无字幕视频不收费）。官方 MCP Registry ID：`io.github.Skyblueballykid/youtube-transcript`。闭源；许可证未知。

en.name: YouTube Transcript Scraper (changefeeds, via Apify MCP)
en.description: Hosted YouTube transcript tool. Accepts video, Shorts, channel or playlist URLs (or bare ids) and returns manual or auto-generated captions as timestamped segments and/or plain text, with title, channel, duration, views and publish date. Requests go through Apify residential proxy, so it works from cloud hosts where YouTube's bot check blocks direct fetches. One Actor tool, `changefeeds--youtube-transcript-scraper`, plus Apify's run and dataset helpers. Streamable HTTP at `https://mcp.apify.com/?tools=changefeeds/youtube-transcript-scraper`; auth: Apify OAuth or `Authorization: Bearer <Apify API token>`. Paid: $0.004 per transcript returned, billed by Apify (videos without captions are not charged). Official MCP Registry id: `io.github.Skyblueballykid/youtube-transcript`. Source is private; license unknown.
